gloss: to be blown away, to vanish

forms.label: Past polite
forms.negative: {吹|ふ}っ{飛|と}びませんでした

forms.label: ている past
forms.negative: {吹|ふ}っ{飛|と}んでいなかった

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {吹|ふ}っ{飛|と}んでいませんでした

definitions.gloss: to be blown away, to fly off
definitions.explanation: To be physically blown away or knocked off by wind, an impact, or force.

definitions.gloss: to vanish, to be wiped out (figurative)
definitions.explanation: Used figuratively to describe something disappearing completely, such as sleepiness, worries, or plans.

examples.japanese: ⟦{帽子|ぼうし}→帽子：00692_boushi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{吹|ふ}っ{飛|と}んだ。
examples.english: My hat was blown away by the wind.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{屋根|やね}→屋根：02264_yane⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{吹|ふ}っ{飛|と}んだ。
examples.english: The roof was blown off by the typhoon.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{知|し}らせ→知らせ：03252_shirase⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧、⟦{眠気|ねむけ}→眠気：06534_nemuke⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{吹|ふ}っ{飛|と}んだ。
examples.english: When I heard that news, my sleepiness vanished completely.

notes:
{吹|ふ}っ{飛|と}ぶ is an emphatic compound of ⟦{吹|ふ}く→吹く：02445_fuku⟧ (to blow) and ⟦{飛|と}ぶ→飛ぶ：00759_tobu⟧ (to fly), with the っ indicating sudden, forceful action.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive)
- Pair: {吹|ふ}っ{飛|と}ばす (transitive, to blow something away)

COMMON FIGURATIVE USES:
- ⟦{眠気|ねむけ}→眠気：06534_nemuke⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{吹|ふ}っ{飛|と}ぶ (sleepiness vanishes)
- ⟦{疲|つか}れ→疲れ：03518_tsukare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{吹|ふ}っ{飛|と}ぶ (tiredness disappears)
- ⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{吹|ふ}っ{飛|と}ぶ (plans are blown away / ruined)
